WITH scores AS (
  SELECT
    c.id,
    CASE WHEN c.do_not_contact OR c.dnc_email OR c.dnc_call OR c.dnc_sms THEN 0
    ELSE GREATEST(0,
      LEAST(15, 5 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.email_logs) e WHERE (e->>'opened_at') IS NOT NULL)) +
      LEAST(25, 5 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activities a WHERE a.contact_id = c.id AND a.is_completed = true)) +
      (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities a WHERE a.contact_id = c.id AND a.type = 'meeting' AND a.subject ILIKE '%inspection%') THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities a WHERE a.contact_id = c.id AND a.type = 'meeting' AND a.subject ILIKE '%inspection%' AND a.is_completed = true) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) +
      COALESCE((SELECT MAX(CASE p.status WHEN 'approved' THEN 30 WHEN 'viewed' THEN 15 WHEN 'emailed' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END)
                FROM proposals p JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = p.opportunity_id WHERE o.contact_id = c.id), 0) +
      (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contracts ct JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = ct.opportunity_id WHERE o.contact_id = c.id AND ct.status = 'signed') THEN 40 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments pay JOIN invoices i ON i.id = pay.invoice_id WHERE i.contact_id = c.id AND i.invoice_type = 'down_payment' AND pay.status = 'paid') THEN 50 ELSE 0 END) +
      COALESCE((SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN o.deal_value > 10000 THEN 15 WHEN o.deal_value > 5000 THEN 10 WHEN o.deal_value > 1000 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END)
                FROM opportunities o WHERE o.contact_id = c.id), 0) +
      (CASE WHEN c.last_contacted_at IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN c.last_contacted_at < now() - interval '30 days' THEN -20
            WHEN c.last_contacted_at < now() - interval '14 days' THEN -10
            ELSE 0 END)
    ) END AS score
  FROM contacts c
  WHERE c.is_archived = false
)
UPDATE contacts
SET lead_score = scores.score
FROM scores
WHERE contacts.id = scores.id AND contacts.lead_score IS DISTINCT FROM scores.score
RETURNING contacts.id, contacts.lead_score;
